description: This file implements a cascade delete operation for a chapter in a learning or content management system. It deletes associated data such as PDFs, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, and embeddings, and updates storage and vector index accordingly.

classes.name: JSONStorage
classes.description: A class for handling JSON-based storage operations.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for managing vector embeddings stored locally, including loading and saving metadata.

methods.name: cascade_delete_chapter
methods.description: Deletes a chapter and all related data, including files, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, and embeddings, updating storage and vector index accordingly.
